# ledger_payment_matches (Data Source)

These are derived reports, not configuration. Balances and bank transaction details are bank-sourced facts from the connected provider; they are kept apart from the person's own corrections (manual payments, status overrides, match decisions) and are not edited here. Payment matches: the link between an occurrence and a bank transaction, with who suggested and decided it. A suggestion is not proof of payment; only confirmed matches count as evidence.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Matches waiting for a decision. A suggestion is not proof of payment.
data "ledger_payment_matches" "suggested" {
  state = "suggested"
}

output "suggestion_count" {
  value = length(data.ledger_payment_matches.suggested.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category_id` (String) Only this category.
- `label_id` (String) Only this label.
- `max_items` (Number) The most items to read (1 to 10000); 1000 when unset.
- `occurrence_id` (String) Only matches of this occurrence.
- `origin` (String) auto_rule, model_suggestion or user.
- `state` (String) suggested, confirmed, rejected or reversed.
- `transaction_id` (String) Only matches of this bank transaction.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API had more items than max_items; narrow the filters or raise max_items.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Attributes) The amount of the transaction assigned to the occurrence. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--amount))
- `bank_text_redacted` (Boolean) Whether the bank's description text was redacted.
- `counts_as_evidence` (Boolean) Whether the match counts as payment evidence.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created.
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who created it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--created_by))
- `decided_at` (String) When, or null.
- `decided_by` (Attributes) Who decided it, or null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--decided_by))
- `history` (Attributes List) What happened to the match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--history))
- `id` (String) The match identifier.
- `needs_review` (Boolean) Whether a person should review it.
- `occurrence_id` (String) The occurrence it pays.
- `origin` (String) auto_rule, model_suggestion or user.
- `reason` (String) The reason given, or null.
- `state` (String) suggested, confirmed, rejected or reversed.
- `transaction` (Attributes) The bank transaction (a bank-sourced fact). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--transaction))
- `transaction_id` (String) The bank transaction.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed.
- `version` (Number) The version.

<a id="nestedatt--items--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Exact decimal amount as a string, in the scale Ledger stores it. Never a floating-point number.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code of amount.

Read-Only:

- `countable` (Boolean) Whether it can count as evidence.
- `counterparty` (String) The counterparty, or null.
- `date` (String) The transaction date.
- `description` (String) The bank's text, or null when redacted.
- `id` (String) The transaction identifier.
- `no_longer_reported_at` (String) When the bank stopped reporting it, or null.
- `provider` (String) The banking provider.
- `source` (String) Always bank.
- `superseded_by` (String) A transaction that replaced it, or null.
- `value_date` (String) Or null.
